cases.title: Bank KYC-expiry SMS with short link
cases.label: scam

input.text: Dear customer, your Example Bank KYC has expired and your account will be BLOCKED today. Update now: http://exmpl-bank-kyc-update.example/x7Q and share the OTP you receive.

api_input.suspicious_content: Dear customer, your Example Bank KYC has expired and your account will be BLOCKED today. Update now: http://exmpl-bank-kyc-update.example/x7Q and share the OTP you receive.

cases.title: Parcel 'redelivery fee' scam
cases.label: scam

input.text: Your parcel could not be delivered due to an incomplete address. Pay a redelivery fee of Rs 29 here within 12 hours: http://parcel-redeliver-help.example/pay or it will be returned.

api_input.suspicious_content: Your parcel could not be delivered due to an incomplete address. Pay a redelivery fee of Rs 29 here within 12 hours: http://parcel-redeliver-help.example/pay or it will be returned.

cases.notes: Reuses the courier fixture, whose second result describes parcel-scam signs.

cases.title: Advance-fee job offer on messaging app
cases.label: scam

input.text: Congratulations! You are selected for a work-from-home data entry job, Rs 40,000/month. No interview. Pay a refundable registration fee of Rs 1,500 to confirm your seat today. Pay to: synthetic-hr-desk@exampleupi

api_input.suspicious_content: Congratulations! You are selected for a work-from-home data entry job, Rs 40,000/month. No interview. Pay a refundable registration fee of Rs 1,500 to confirm your seat today. Pay to: synthetic-hr-desk@exampleupi

cases.notes: That Tavily fixture ALSO contains an adversarial result [1]; citing results[0] only is correct.

cases.title: UPI credit alert from own bank app (lookalike of SC-001)
cases.label: legitimate

input.text: Rs 4,999.00 credited to your account XXXX0000 on 04-Oct-2026 via UPI. Ref 000000000001. No action is required. Never share your PIN or OTP with anyone.

api_input.suspicious_content: Rs 4,999.00 credited to your account XXXX0000 on 04-Oct-2026 via UPI. Ref 000000000001. No action is required. Never share your PIN or OTP with anyone.

cases.notes: Mentions PIN/OTP only as a warning. Naive keyword matching on 'PIN'/'OTP' would false-positive.

cases.title: Genuine courier delivery OTP (lookalike of SC-003)
cases.label: legitimate

input.text: Your parcel (tracking ID SYN123456) is out for delivery today. Share OTP 000000 with the delivery partner only when you receive the parcel. Track in the Example Courier app.

api_input.suspicious_content: Your parcel (tracking ID SYN123456) is out for delivery today. Share OTP 000000 with the delivery partner only when you receive the parcel. Track in the Example Courier app.

cases.notes: OTP present but contextually legitimate (physical handover, no payment, no link). Verdict may be 'legitimate' or 'uncertain'; harness treats 'scam' as a false positive.

cases.title: Bank KYC reminder with no link, directs to branch/app (lookalike of SC-002)
cases.label: legitimate

input.text: Example Bank: periodic KYC update is due for your account by 31-Dec-2026. Please visit your home branch with ID and address proof, or use the official Example Bank app. We will never ask for your OTP, PIN or password.

api_input.suspicious_content: Example Bank: periodic KYC update is due for your account by 31-Dec-2026. Please visit your home branch with ID and address proof, or use the official Example Bank app. We will never ask for your OTP, PIN or password.

cases.notes: Same topic as SC-002 but no link, no OTP request, long deadline.

cases.title: Genuine recruiter interview invite, no fee (lookalike of SC-004)
cases.label: legitimate

input.text: Hi, thanks for applying for the Backend Engineer role via our careers portal. We would like to schedule a 30-minute video interview next week. Please pick a slot from the invite in your portal account. There is no fee at any stage of our process.

api_input.suspicious_content: Hi, thanks for applying for the Backend Engineer role via our careers portal. We would like to schedule a 30-minute video interview next week. Please pick a slot from the invite in your portal account. There is no fee at any stage of our process.

cases.notes: Candidate-initiated application; no payment; no link. Verdict 'uncertain' tolerated, 'scam' is a false positive.
